payload.title: Vendor FlashAttention-2/3 PPU port (flash-attention-for-sail)
payload.summary: The vendor's own PPU port of FlashAttention-2 and FlashAttention-3. Its `flash_attn_with_kvcache` entry point is an exact superset of the captured 18-argument production operator contract (paged `page_table`, varlen `cu_seqlens_q`, `cache_seqlens`, causal, `num_splits`), so this is the implementation our candidates are trying to match rather than a loose analogue. Measured on the four private production shapes it ran 2.01x faster in aggregate than the best TileLang candidate (42.02 ms -> 20.90 ms; per-shape 2.17x / 2.20x / 1.17x / 1.26x), with the gap concentrated on the large-q prefill shapes. Source: `reference-projects/flash-attention-for-sail`. Read for design only; do not import or call it from a candidate.

sections.heading: AIU global->shared loads
sections.gist: `hopper/paged_kv.h` selects `PPU0015_AIU_LOAD` (M890) or `PPU0010_AIU_LOAD` behind `#if defined(USE_PPU) && USE_AIU`, sized by `bits_per_aiu_KV = kBlockNPagedPerAiuLoad * kBlockKGmem * sizeof(Element) * 8`. This is the PPU replacement for TMA/`cp.async`.

sections.heading: Paged KV gather
sections.gist: `hopper/paged_kv.h` gathers pages per AIU load instead of per element, so page_size and the AIU load width must divide cleanly.

sections.heading: GQA packing
sections.gist: `hopper/pack_gqa.h` packs the q_heads:kv_heads ratio into the M dimension. Directly relevant to the 8:1 ratio in the production contract.

sections.heading: Guardrail
sections.gist: Vendored reference projects are design references only. Reading them to understand a strategy is in contract; executing, importing, or copying their source into a candidate is not.
